\chapter{Comprehensive genealogical atlas of the 324 mass routes}
\label{chap:atlas-genealogico-exhaustivo-324-rutas}
\noindent\hyperref[chap:portal-atlas-inventarios-masas]{Return to the scientific portal of the atlas and its readers.}
Each entry brings together cell identity, orientation, dodecaphase word, bidirectional readers, returns, memory, carry, and signature. No metrological magnitude participates in this reconstruction.

The census satisfies

\[81\ \text{cells}\times4\ \text{orientations}=324\ \text{routes}.\]
